text_en: Choose two correct alternatives of passive voice. 'Hrishikesh gave his brother a nice gift.'
opts_en: Hrishikesh was given his brother a nice gift.
His brother was given a nice gift by Hrishikesh.
A nice gift was given his brother by Hrishikesh.
A nice gift is given his brother by Hrishikesh.

text_en: Find the number of common nouns in the following sentence. 'The emperor asked the man to explain the lion's strange behaviour.'
Fill in the blank with proper modal auxiliary showing possibility. 'It is cloudy. It __________ rain today.'
Choose correct alternative.
opts_en: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
The Earth revolved around the Sun.
The Earth will revolve around the Sun.
The Earth should revolve around the Sun.

text_en: Choose the correct sentence of 'past perfect tense'.
opts_en: The headmaster will have spoken to students.
The headmaster will be speaking to students.
The headmaster had spoken to students.

text_en: Choose correct alternative. 'He said to him, "Please wait here till I return."'
opts_en: He commanded him if to wait there till he return.
He said him that wait there till he returned.
He requested him to wait there till he returned.
He ordered him to wait here till he returned.
